lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: why all circles are similar

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: An inscribed angle intercepts a 100° arc. Find it.

steps: Inscribed angle is half the arc.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: A circle has radius 3. From an external point 5 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 8, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
4, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
2, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
4, because the tangent bisects the radius

items.prompt: A circle has radius 12. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 30°, in terms of π.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 65°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 176°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 8. From an external point 17 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 15, because the tangent bisects the radius
25, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
15, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
9, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

items.prompt: A circle has radius 12. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 45°, in terms of π.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 99°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 92°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
